The three classic-satellite pictures cover 803 cards from 110 name families, but 665 of them are "Cosmos" (a cover name for dozens of Soviet types: Zenit/Yantar recon, Strela, Parus, Tselina, Okean, US-K, Taifun, etc.), plus Landsat, SPOT, Okean, Kiku, Nova, Intercosmos, Starlette, GEOS... At least 30 visually distinct buses. Honest options: (1) for Cosmos, use data/series.json (already maps many NORAD ids to programmes) to route each to a per-programme picture (Strela, Parus, Tselina, Zenit, Meteor already exist); (2) give the remainder a deliberately schematic "unknown satellite" silhouette or a line-drawing of the satellite's own catalogue shape class; (3) for named Western ones with PD photos (Landsat, GEOS, NOAA/Nova) add own pictures. Picture shows a busy box with dish and one wing: reads as a specific but non-existent satellite.

object: Catch-all "satellite 2000 onward" (variation 1 of 4: large EO box with big wing)

Too varied to depict; assignment is by NORAD id, so a CubeSat card can get the big EO bus and vice versa.
